Use explicit per-frame sourceRect; artwork does not align to uniform cells.

scan.description: Whole-field visual scan: retract antenna, deploy and turn roof radar, retract dish, restore antenna. Empty hands remain lowered. Forward work pose independent of heading; no sensing logic or game state mutation.

decisionThinking.description: Visual status only. Eye sides are viewer-relative. Thinking repeats until the caller supplies a result or another action. Result is provided externally; do not infer or randomly generate a condition outcome.

decisionTrue.description: Visual status only. Eye sides are viewer-relative. Thinking repeats until the caller supplies a result or another action. Result is provided externally; do not infer or randomly generate a condition outcome.

decisionFalse.description: Visual status only. Eye sides are viewer-relative. Thinking repeats until the caller supplies a result or another action. Result is provided externally; do not infer or randomly generate a condition outcome.

decisionLights.note: Colors are generation targets. Actual eye pixels are baked into the robot-decision-v01.png frames. No extra light overlay or glow filter is needed. These clips are empty-hand front work poses; preserve cargo and use separate carry variants if the game needs loaded decision poses.

soilVariants.composition: Draw layers in ascending z onto one soil canvas, below the existing plant layer. destinationRect uses canvas pixels; sourceRect uses atlas pixels. Never mutate the base atlas.
soilVariants.selection: Persist the chosen variant ID per tile; do not choose a new variant during animation or redraw.

areaScanWave.layerPlacement: Above soil and plants, below robot and cargo; preserve existing rendering.layerOrder.
areaScanWave.sampling: sourceRect in atlas pixels. Center each frame at anchor within fieldBounds; sizeRatio is width/height relative to fieldBounds. frameIndexByStep and opacityByStep follow the owning animation clip playback steps, not sprite indices. Clip to union of actual field cell rectangles for irregular fields. Null frame is hidden.
areaScanWave.reducedMotion: Respect the shared paused/reduced-motion playback setting; do not run an independent effect timer.

placement.description: Bottom-left of the bubble canvas anchored to these normalized robot-canvas coordinates. Height follows canvas aspect. Draw above robot and cargo; do not change existing rendering.layerOrder.

thoughtBubbles.note: Bubble animation has its own elapsed-time cursor within the shared render clock; do not use the eye/shell frame index for dot phases. Source art includes the cream cloud, thought puffs and pictogram. Result selection comes from external game logic. Scan, carry, harvest, movement and idle have no bubble mapping.

coordinateRules.file: Relative to assets/; existing paths unchanged.
coordinateRules.textRect: [x,y,width,height] relative to sourceRect top-left, in unscaled source pixels. Apply the same scale/translation as the sign image.
coordinateRules.groundAnchor: [x,y] relative to sourceRect top-left in source pixels; stake tip insertion reference.
coordinateRules.repeat: unitSize and step are SOURCE pixel dimensions. Repeat sourceRect without its surrounding atlas padding; use recommendedDisplaySize for logical display tile dimensions. Never repeat the entire PNG for greenhouse or floor.
coordinateRules.recommendedDisplaySize: [width,height] logical CSS/game pixels at 1x. Icons use contain; signs preserve source aspect when fitting this box.
coordinateRules.alpha: RGBA originals; transparent exterior and tile grout. Do not flatten over a background when exporting.

repeat.verification: Visually continuous mid-mullion join; generated pixel colors retain minor sub-level variation, not a byte-identical periodic texture.
All four source-unit edge alpha values are zero. Repeat over a chosen grout/floor color; retain transparent grout gaps.

mainScreenAssets.note: Static art only; no new animation, growth, sensing, economic, token-cost or currency logic. Existing manifest fields including root version remain unchanged.

valleyFarm.name: 山谷農田・輕微俯角

grass.note: Transparent sparse tufts over baseColor, all four outer edges alpha0.

soilFront.sourceSpace: Full image pixels; sample only the solid bands, excluding margins and stray generation specks.

farmhouse.label: 科技農舍
farmhouse.anchorSpace: Pixels relative to sourceRect top-left; bottom of entrance/foundation.
farmhouse.note: Static artwork only. Solar panels and antenna are painted details; no light, door or production animation. Keep original aspect in both ground views.

environment.rectSpace: Normalized [x,y,width,height] of viewport. Background layers scale independently of grid; never squash upright sprites.

projection.interactionNote: Invert only the ground projection for cell picking and placement. Exclude the decorative frontDepth from cell hit bounds; keep all existing game grid/collision rules. Claude owns game integration.

terrain.frontRule: Draw a front face only if the neighbor cell at [x+frontNeighbor[0],y+frontNeighbor[1]] is absent from the combined occupied-cell set. Test across plot boundaries too. Draw below y+tileHeight, with width=tileWidth and height=frontDepth. No interior dividing soil wall.
terrain.seamRule: Adjacent top faces share the exact grid boundary; no per-cell gap, rotation, skew or corner rounding. Corners use straight cut ends of the front strip.

uprightSprites.rule: Compress only soil/ground surfaces. Keep plants, robots, held produce, thought bubbles and signs upright at their original aspect ratio.

depthOrder.rule: Sort all upright sprites globally by their projected ground anchor, across plot boundaries. Draw increasing groundY; nearer plants may occlude robots farther back. Cargo/thought bubbles belong to the same robot draw group. Front soil walls are terrain, not upright sprites.

preview.note: Static composition preview; no game mechanics or independent animation timer.
preview.signAnchorRule: Use [minimum field cell x, maximum field cell y] + signOffset, then project to screen; signs stand beside the lower-left outer edge.
preview.propPositionSpace: Preview canvas logical pixels; groundPosition is the projected ground anchor. Game chooses placement independently.

valleyFarm.note: Additive data; previous manifest fields, asset paths and alignment shape unchanged. Game projection, picking, dragging, movement rendering and final occlusion integration remain Claude responsibilities.

landBoundary.label: 低矮木樁與繩索界線

geometry.input: Union of integer [x,y] cells belonging to ONE displayed land range, regardless of crop/soil/plot grouping. Do not create fences between cells of this same set.
geometry.rule: Emit an edge only if its side neighbor is absent from the union. Add both integer endpoints to a unique vertex set. Place one post per unique vertex, even at concave corners; no doubled stakes or interior edges. Disconnected components and enclosed holes follow the same rule.
geometry.expansionVisualRule: After game-owned range cells change, rebuild this geometry from the new set. Shared edges vanish; retained edges stay fixed. This is presentation data, not expansion eligibility/cost/collision logic.

placement.horizontalRule: Map rope endpoint ratios to projected boundary endpoints shifted upward by ropeElevation; stretch span only along grid X, use displayThickness on Y.
placement.verticalRule: Map endpoints to projected boundary endpoints shifted upward by ropeElevation; stretch span only along grid Y, use displayThickness on X.
placement.postRule: Contain in recommendedDisplaySize, keep aspect, align local groundAnchor to projected grid vertex. Never rotate the stake or flatten its height.

depthOrder.ropeGroundKey: projected segment midpoint, before elevation offset
depthOrder.rule: Merge with plants, robots, signs and props in global ground order. Terrain first. Do not draw the whole boundary as a final overlay; near crops may cover rear ropes.

landBoundary.note: Opaque narrow sprites over transparent alpha; no wide fence panels, floor, mesh or animation. Land area state and game integration remain Claude responsibilities.

farmhouseAngled.anchorDescription: Front doorstep ground contact; local sourceRect pixels. Footprint is approximate art occupancy, not collision geometry.
farmhouseAngled.cameraNote: Illustrated elevated three-quarter view with sloping front foundation. Hand-drawn roof and side-wall perspective is approximate, not a mathematically projected mesh.

coordinateSpaces.groundAnchor: Pixels relative to sourceRect top-left; scale with the same contain scale as the source sprite. Ground tiles use cell center. Backdrops/frames carry a reference anchor but are positioned in viewport space.
coordinateSpaces.footprint: Grid-cell extents for art placement only, not collision/purchase rules. [0,0] means viewport decoration independent of the grid.
coordinateSpaces.recommendedDisplaySize: Unprojected logical pixel contain box at 64px per grid cell. Ground tiles are exactly 64×64 before rotation/compression.
coordinateSpaces.viewportRatio: [width,height] fractions of the viewport; these are independent frame suggestions, not a game UI safe area guarantee.

projection.screenToGrid: dx=screenX-originX; dy=(screenY-originY)/scaleY; gridX=(dx*cos(theta)+dy*sin(theta))/64; gridY=(-dx*sin(theta)+dy*cos(theta))/64; floor only for cell picking
projection.note: tileSize=[64,40] is the unrotated compressed baseline, not the rotated cell screen bounds. Apply R(18deg) to square ground then S(1,40/64); no whole-scene CSS transform. Existing valleyFarm.projection and its views stay unchanged.
projection.uprightRule: Project only the ground anchor. Draw the entire upright sprite at original aspect and screen-vertical orientation. Robot/cargo/thought bubble remain one unflattened draw group.

rendering.uprightRule: Merge all props, crops, robots, signs, buildings and boundary posts into ONE global list sorted by projected anchors across plots. Foreground-frame is the only intentional final overlay.

frontWalls.rule: Use exposed sides of the union of occupied cells. For each clockwise projected side a→b, screen outward normal is [b.y-a.y, -(b.x-a.x)]. Draw only if neighbor absent AND normal.y>0. Extrude that screen edge vertically down by frontDepth. Do not draw internal walls or flatten the upright sprites.

rendering.repeatRule: Build each ground tile in 64×64 square coordinates and project the shared ground plane once. No per-cell pre-rotation, no additional gap. drawImage smoothing disabled.
rendering.frameFit: Contain inside viewportRect and align to specified edge; fit=cover-width uses full viewportRect width and clips at screen edges. All frame sprites keep their aspect. Backdrops may stretch to viewportRect.

animation.note: Every new asset is static. No light flicker, water animation, tree sway or separate animation clock. Existing robot animation rules remain in animationClips/alignment.

performance.loadPolicy: Load each distinct file once and reuse for every sourceRect.
performance.optimization: User authorized on 2026-10-17: nearest-neighbor 50% resize, alpha threshold128, palette reduction without dithering. All new runtime PNGs binary-alpha indexed images. Original generated PNGs preserved separately.

compositionV20.decalRule: Source patches are top-down; draw centered in logical grid, mirror per item, then apply shared ground projection once. Paint after ground surfaces and before walls/upright sprites. No random per-frame placement.

board.coordinateConvention: zero-based x east, y south; integer cells; vertices extend to x12/y7

existingRules.costScope: land only; excludes plot purchases, robots, capacity and Token exchange

expansion.phaseSemantics: Suggested spatial milestones only, not forced progression gates or a change to canBuyLand. Every cell in board remains eligible under existing adjacency rules.

environment.boardArtPolicy: All84 cells remain uncluttered; do not bake crops, plot shapes, fences, grid labels, trees, buildings, paths or purchase states into board image. Minor grass texture only.
environment.zoneSpace: logical board grid units; non-playable scenic zones outside board
environment.decorationCollision: None added. Scene decoration stays outside board; existing simulation has no environmental blockers or cross-plot pathfinding.

topDown.buildingRule: Use overhead roof art baked into environmental map; never flatten angled farmhouse sprite.
topDown.foregroundRule: Do not overlay angled foreground frames in arrangement mode; keep all grid targets visible.
topDown.registrationNote: Board calibrated against final generated art; planning overlay, not generated pixels, is authoritative. All84 cells are in uninterrupted grass.

angledTarget.status: Art target only. Current game/valley.js uses unrotated96x60 cells, not this formula. Existing valleyScene five demonstration beds are not a state.layout snapshot.

compatibility.assetLoading: Current game/render.js loadAssets enumerates valleyFarm etc.; Claude must add farmWorld assets explicitly. Existing game does not load this new root automatically.
compatibility.ownership: ChatGPT supplies assets, plan and lab; Claude integrates state.land/state.layout, renderer transforms, camera and input inverse.
compatibility.savePolicy: Preserve existing state.land and layout; phases do not reset or relocate existing player plots.
compatibility.switchPolicy: Keep board cell and rot unchanged when switching views; only project same world positions. Never derive land from PNG colors.
compatibility.loopPolicy: Arrangement currently does not pause simulation; this plan does not change it.
compatibility.mapToGamePixel: Map pixels → existing top-down renderer: [(mapX-224)*1.5,129.6+(mapY-576)*1.5]; combine with camera/viewport transform.

animation.note: Static planning/map only. Switching preview views is immediate; existing game robot clips remain unchanged.

lab.note: Read-only art/land-layout preview. No purchasing, save access, economic simulation or real drag mode.

overheadMap.label: 山谷農場・完全俯視環境地圖
overheadMap.anchorMeaning: board vertex(0,0), local sourceRect pixels; environmental-map registration, not building root
overheadMap.processing: nearest-neighbor resize to1280 square; alpha threshold128; FASTOCTREE palette reduction without dithering; original preserved
